mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation rate above 0.3% triggers a risk premium adjustment that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) after inflation crosses 0.3%, or the effect persists only in low-inflation regimes.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS labor costs exceeding 0.5% signals wage stickiness, which reduces expected future profit margins and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by more than 0.5% from the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns over the next 60 days remain non-negative in >70% of such labor-cost spikes, or the effect is absent in non-crisis labor markets.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly increase in HOUST industrial production exceeding 2% indicates strengthening supply-side demand, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST shows three consecutive months of gains >2%
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) after the pattern, or the effect is not robust across multiple economic shocks.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in INDPRO supply index below 97.5 (annualized) suggests tight supply conditions, which amplifies equity risk premia and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 97.5 in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >50% of such supply shocks, or the effect is absent during non-crisis supply environments.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 5.25% for two consecutive months, the S&P 500 is expected to underperform over the next 60 trading days due to higher real borrowing costs.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases for two consecutive months above 5.25%
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) after the rate hike pattern, or the effect is muted in low-volatility regimes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE below 3% for three months suggests labor market slack, which reduces equity risk aversion and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 3% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive (p > 0.05) during the slack period, or the effect is not observed outside recessionary contexts.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly increases in GDPC1 (demand) and RSAFS (retail sales) above their 2023 Q4 averages for two months predict positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days due to stronger consumer and business demand.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 2023-Q4 avg and RSAFS > 2023-Q4 avg for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) after the interaction, or the effect is not robust to lagged controls.

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS falls by more than 10% in a single month compared to the prior month, it indicates a supply disruption that is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decreases by >10% from prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) after the drop, or the effect is absent in non-crisis supply events.
